name: mcp
title: MCP, connected apps and API keys
summary: People connect agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude Code) by URL and sign in, or use personal API keys; the agent calls the app's tools over MCP as them.

env.name: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE
env.doc: MCP requests allowed per API key per minute.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_ACCESS_TTL
env.doc: How long an OAuth access token lasts (1m to 24h).

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_REFRESH_TTL
env.doc: How long a refresh token lasts; each refresh issues a new one, so a connection unused this long ends.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_REGISTRATIONS_PER_HOUR
env.doc: Dynamic client registrations allowed per IP per hour.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_MAX_UNUSED_CLIENTS
env.doc: Registered OAuth clients that have never been used, at most; registration pauses at the cap until the hourly prune.

env.name: MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_ENABLED
env.doc: Accept https client_id URLs (client ID metadata documents), which the server fetches through a private-address guard.

wire.insert: import { mcpAdminNav, mcpConnectedAppsSettings, mcpConnectionsAdminNav, mcpSettings } from "./mcp/nav";

stitch: Make sure each feature agents should use implements app.ToolProvider with prescriptive descriptions; write tools are offered only to connections with the write scope.
Install the agents feature if people should set AI agent scope (off, read, suggest, edit per feature and resource); without it every call runs with the connection's scope only.
Rewrite the server instructions, resource_name and card description in backend/internal/mcp/mcp.go and the consent copy in web/src/features/mcp/ConnectScreen.tsx for this app.
Serve the API at the origin PUBLIC_API_URL names (no path prefix): /mcp, /.well-known/* and /oauth/* live at its root, and PUBLIC_API_URL is the OAuth issuer.
Set PUBLIC_WEB_URL: /oauth/authorize sends people to its /connect page to sign in and consent. OAuth is off without it.
Decide whether hosted clients may use client ID metadata documents (MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_ENABLED); turn it off if the API must make no outbound requests.
